repo_side_fixes_shipped_this_pass.description: Parallel session claimed batch 1509 mid-flight (offline workflow apply + IAM unified enqueue + CDN/glocal at SOT line 3). My prior batch 1509 (Audit P1 Closure) at SOT line 1908 was marked as 'superseded alias — parallel session's offline workflow apply at SOT line 3 is the canonical batch 1509'. Both bodies of work are legitimate and independent.

Parallel session added docs/plans/UNIFIED_WIZARD_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md which matches the (plan|roadmap|remediation|master) pattern. Baseline bumped 163 → 164. Root cap unchanged at 120 because the new plan lives under docs/plans/.

Parallel session inserted a FINANCE_GLOCAL block at line 1083 of apps/siteconfig/context_processors.py that referenced `school_for_chrome` before its assignment at line 1113, producing UnboundLocalError on every authenticated tenant request. Fixed by replacing the early reference with `school_for_offline_cfg` (same `getattr(request, 'school', None)` expression assigned earlier in the function).

Depth test passed CanonicalField(description=, canonical_type='string') but the real dataclass has no `description` field and `canonical_type` must be one of CANONICAL_FIELD_TYPES (frozenset). Test rewritten to use real API and to assert frozenset rather than tuple.

templates/finance/permission_to_pay.html used {% block portal_main %} but portal_base.html defines {% block content %} (line 550). Block name mismatch silently dropped the form body. Fixed to {% block content %}.

Template {% url 'permission_to_pay_approve' %} / 'permission_to_pay_authorize' failed NoReverseMatch because apps/accounts/urls.py is included under namespace='accounts' in config/tenant_urls.py. Fixed to {% url 'accounts:permission_to_pay_approve' %} and 'accounts:permission_to_pay_authorize'.

All 3 micro-friction view-test modules used RequestFactory which bypasses host middleware, so the URL resolver fell back to default ROOT_URLCONF instead of config.tenant_urls. Added set_urlconf('config.tenant_urls') in setUp() and set_urlconf(None) in tearDown() across permission_to_pay, substitute_handover, and lost_belongings view tests.

Bound forms re-rendered with submitted POST values, echoing raw student_id / teacher_id / asset_id / staff_id / finder notes into the HTML input value= attributes — defeating the hashed-ID render discipline. Fixed all 3 services to swap to a fresh unbound form on the success branch (and `initial={'notify_parent': True}` for the anonymous finder loop). Affects substitute_handover_create, permission_to_pay_open, lost_belongings_mint, lost_belongings_lookup, lost_belongings_recover.
